messages:
Riley (Eng Manager): Quick follow-up from today's All-Hands Q&A 12; we discussed shifting majors to every-other-week. Wanted to capture how this affects oncall rotations and the quality gates.
Sam (VP Eng): Short answer: no extra oncall headcount, but release weeks will include a focused verification shift; owners must be explicit.
Priya (Product): Can we standardize what counts as a 'major'? My proposal: any release that touches public API, storage schema, or billing is major. Otherwise minor.
Diego (SRE): For majors we require: canary (4h min), staged traffic increase plan, and automated rollback criteria. Also suggest a 48h post-rollout watch with reduced thresholds.
Neha (QA): Quality bar proposal for majors: zero critical failures, >95% pass on smoke + regression suite, and no more than 2 flaky tests unresolved. We should also define a fast hotfix path if something slips.
Jamie (Eng Ops): I'll add a release_type field to our ticket template (major/minor/hotfix) and a freeze_date. Ops will own the RFC for customer comms and maintenance windows.
Riley (Eng Manager): Good. Who writes the quick checklist? I can draft a 1-page triage+verify doc. Need volunteers to review.
Neha (QA): I'll draft the QA checklist and include the regression command snippet:
```
# quick regression
python tests/run_regression.py --suite regression_core --env staging --max-fail 0 --flaky-tol 2
```
I'll put full details in Confluence.
Diego (SRE): Rollback rule suggestion: if error_rate jumps >0.5% OR p99 increases by >35% during canary or 48h watch -> auto-create incident and flag for rollback. Auto-rollback if critical user paths fail.
deploy-bot: "Canary scheduled: 10% at 13:00 UTC. Watch p95/p99, error-rate, latency. Rollback threshold set."
Priya (Product): For customer-facing SLAs: hosted API remains 99.9%. We should add a line in the status page docs about potential short blips during majors and link to rollback policy. Ops to draft wording.
Sam (VP Eng): Leadership asks: make majors predictable, minimize customer impact, and keep hotfixes fast. Ops + Release + QA finalize checklist by Thursday so we can pilot next cycle.
Jamie (Eng Ops): Owners: Jamie (ticket template + ops RFC + customer language), Neha (QA checklist), Diego (monitoring + rollback criteria), Riley (final checklist draft). I'll drop the template JSON in #eng-docs.
Riley (Eng Manager): Thanks. I'll schedule a 30m sync Wednesday to walk through. Closing thread 10; will post notes after the sync.
